189:t_014:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I meant nothing by it. I just wanted to know.」

189:t_014:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you want to shake off that sullen act too, just like $n, huh!」

189:t_014:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll teach you what defeat is!」

189:t_014:9.en:
$n
「And we'll strip that composure right off you!」

189:t_015:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Seven minutes have passed since the operation began...!」

189:t_015:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hurry! If we can't wipe out the enemy within one more minute, we'll be forced to change the atmospheric entry course!」

189:t_015:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「If that happens, we'll be late getting to $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$...!」

189:t_015:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, charge! We can't afford to dawdle in a place like this!」

189:t_016:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Eight minutes have passed since the operation began! We can't enter the atmosphere on the planned course!」

189:t_016:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn...! Do we have to rework the whole operation from scratch!?」

189:t_100:0.en:
$n
「$$尸空#pilot$$! I'm paying you back for everything so far!」

189:t_100:2.en:
$n
「What are you talking about at this late stage!」

189:t_100:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Either way, the factors fall short.」

189:t_100:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The essence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$... If you can't reach it, I have no use for you.」

189:t_100:5.en:
$n
「You may have no use for me, but I've got one for you!」

189:t_100:6.en:
$n
「I don't care about some fate between Reactors! I'll take you down right here!」

189:t_101:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Thanks for the hospitality back on $$翠の地球$$!」

189:t_101:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry to say, I know even the smile my old master drilled into me won't work on you...」

189:t_101:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「So today I'm going with brute force! Get ready for it!」

189:t_101:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「W-what the...! Suddenly calling out my street name like that!」

189:t_101:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I see... So this is what they call karma.」

189:t_101:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit spouting nonsense! Is that 'void' of yours supposed to mean there's nothing in your head, either!?」

189:t_102:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Well...? Feel like coming over to our side?」

189:t_102:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I have no intention of listening to the words of those who invaded Earth.」

189:t_102:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「As long as I have the pride of the 《$$グローリー・スター$$》, I'll keep fighting!」

189:t_102:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「A star shining in the darkness... I see... So that's how it is...」

189:t_102:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルゴラ・グローリー$$...! Give me strength!」

189:t_103:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're stating the obvious, $$ノノ$$! They're robots loaded with combat AI! They're not like you!」

189:t_103:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No, they're not different. A heart dwells in every existence!」

189:t_103:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So $$ノノ$$ will fight you! $$ノノ$$ won't forgive anything ruled by an evil heart!」

189:t_104:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Enemy unmanned units have entered combat range.」

189:t_104:1.en:
$$レド$$
「What is the difference between you and them, I wonder...」

189:t_104:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System. Its reason for existing is established only by the existence of its occupant.」

189:t_104:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As a control AI for attack weapons, the enemy units exist to exterminate humanity. Their development process is entirely different from this unit's.」

189:t_104:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I also recognize that they are the enemy. Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$...!」

189:t_105:0.en:
$$アル$$
「How sad. An AI that just carries out its mission without even speaking words, like those.」

189:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is how a weapon ought to be. You are the anomaly.」

189:t_105:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, balancing being a mercenary with being a high school student makes you quite an anomaly as well.」

189:t_105:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Since I make full use of an anomalous AI, I accept that I am anomalous myself.」

189:t_105:4.en:
$$アル$$
「With all due respect, I'll be returning that argument of yours to you word for word.」

189:t_106:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
(It's not those robots that are at fault... The one who ordered them to fight is the worst villain of all...)

189:t_106:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
(I'll fight...! Against anyone who uses robots for evil!)

189:t_106:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
(I'll use $$鉄人$$'s power for what's right, and I'll raise $$オックス$$ into a robot with a righteous heart!)

189:t_107:0.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Earth for the first time in a while, huh.」

189:t_107:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Both the green one and the blue one are beautiful.」

189:t_107:2.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「There are people targeting that Earth.」

189:t_107:3.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Fighting them is the mission of the $$クラッシャー隊$$.」

189:t_107:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's go, everyone! To bring peace back to Earth!」

189:t_107:6.en:
$$タケル$$
(I'll do it, Brother...! I'll dedicate my life and the power of $$ゴッドマーズ$$ to the peace of this universe!)
